The supplied deterministic grounding accepts all required fact realizations, finds no duplicate assignments, and identifies no unknown scene obligations.

The evidence is presented in coherent prose paragraphs rather than explicit tables, bullet ledgers, or a personnel-index wall. Each indexed participant's stream statuses can be recovered unambiguously.
The narrative gives the accepted tally and rule but explicitly leaves the identity to the checksum; it does not assert Zion Brooks as the answer.
No person is assigned contradictory statuses within the same evidence stream. The separate evidence sweeps collectively provide one status per stream for each reviewed participant.
The main, intermediate, scalar, and counterfactual questions are answerable from the stated protocol and evidence.
